title: Deliverect catalog
subtitle: The one whitelist of materials Deliverect lists on every delivery platform, and the platforms each material is excluded on.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the Deliverect catalog
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Deliverect catalog grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

results.failedTitle: The whitelist could not be read
results.failed: The whitelist could not be read. Try again in a moment.

import.title: Import materials into the whitelist
import.note: Paste material numbers, one per line, or pick an .xlsx file with one column. A material already on the whitelist is re-activated.
import.headerSkipped: The first line, “<header>{{header}}</header>”, holds no material number and is skipped as a header.
import.overCap_one: One import takes at most {{max}} materials. Remove {{overBy}} material to send.
import.overCap_other: One import takes at most {{max}} materials. Remove {{overBy}} materials to send.

file.unreadable: {{fileName}} could not be read as an .xlsx workbook.
file.otherColumns: {{fileName}} has more than one column. Keep only the material numbers in the first column.
file.overCap_one: {{fileName}} holds {{n}} material — one import takes at most {{max}}. Split the file.
file.overCap_other: {{fileName}} holds {{n}} materials — one import takes at most {{max}}. Split the file.

result.title: Import done
result.unknownHint: These material numbers are not known, so they were not imported.
result.copiedDetail_one: {{n}} unknown material number is on the clipboard.
result.copiedDetail_other: {{n}} unknown material numbers are on the clipboard.
result.copyFailed: Could not copy — this page has no clipboard access.

disable.title: Disable the material
disable.note: A disabled material is sent as out of stock on every delivery platform at the next sync. It stays on the whitelist and can be restored.

delete.title: Delete the material
delete.note: A deleted material is sent as out of stock on every delivery platform at the next sync and leaves the active whitelist. It can be restored.

restore.title: Restore the material
restore.note: The material is back on the whitelist, sold with its real stock on every delivery platform it is not excluded on, from the next sync.

exclusions.title: Platform exclusions
exclusions.note: Untick a delivery platform to exclude the material there. Excluded means out of stock on that platform only — every other platform still sees its real stock. Saving replaces the material’s exclusions.
exclusions.unlisted: Also excluded on these platforms, which the platform list does not show. They stay excluded.
exclusions.unavailableHint: The delivery platforms could not be read, so the exclusions cannot be edited here. Nothing was changed.
exclusions.noPlatforms: No delivery platform is set up yet.

push.title: Push the catalog now
push.note: Sends the whole whitelist to one Deliverect account now, as the catalog its delivery platforms list.
push.fallbackHint: No account can be chosen from the account list here — type the account key.
push.deliverectAnswer: Deliverect did not take the catalog. Its answer:
push.failedHint: The catalog could not be pushed.
